Capture the full configuration of the current space as a versioned JSON snapshot.

Stores the snapshot in the knowledge base. Returns snapshot_id for later revert.

description:
Update the current space's SwappableIntelligence harness configuration.

Each parameter targets a specific key in the stored configuration. Only provided
(non-None) parameters are written; everything else in the existing config is preserved.
Use get_conduct_config first to inspect the current state.
Creates a pre-update snapshot before applying changes.

agent_md_instructions.description: Admin AGENT.md content injected into the workspace (setup.agentMdInstructions).

claude_autocompact_pct.description: Context autocompact threshold percentage for claude_code (10–95).

claude_effort.description: Reasoning effort level for the claude_code strategy.

claude_max_context_tokens.description: Maximum context window tokens for claude_code (50 000–500 000).

claude_model.description: Claude model ID for the claude_code/claude_sandbox strategy.

claude_permission_mode.description: Tool permission mode for the claude_code strategy. 'bypassPermissions' skips all confirmation prompts.

codex_model.description: Model ID for the codex strategy.

codex_reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort level for the codex strategy.

custom_instructions.description: Instructions appended to the agent system prompt (setup.customInstructions).

enable_code_execution.description: Enable bash/write/read tools in the agent (setup.enableCodeExecution).

max_history_interactions.description: Maximum number of past chat messages included as history context (setup.maxHistoryInteractions). Set to 0 to disable history.

max_turns.description: Maximum agent turns (1–1000). Applied to the active strategy block (claude.maxTurns, piAgent.maxTurns, or codex.maxTurns).

mcp_integration_mode.description: How MCP servers are exposed to the agent: as 'tools' or 'skills' (setup.mcpIntegrationMode).

pi_agent_model_name.description: Model ID for the pi_agent strategy.

pi_agent_thinking_level.description: Thinking depth for the pi_agent strategy.

progress_update_abort_s.description: Abort the agent after this many seconds without a progress update. Set to null/None to disable (setup.progressUpdateAbortS).

show_thinking_in_chat.description: Show agent thinking steps in the chat UI (setup.showThinkingInChat).

show_tool_calls_in_chat.description: Show tool calls in the chat UI (setup.showToolCallsInChat).

strategy.description: Agent execution strategy. 'claude_code' is the standard Claude Code runner. 'pi_agent' uses a Pi-model runner. 'codex' uses an OpenAI Codex runner.

system_prompt_override.description: When non-empty, fully replaces the agent system prompt (setup.systemPromptOverride).

name: update_conduct_config
title: Update Conduct Config

description:
Update a Magic Table space's RfpAgent module and/or space-level settings.

Updates the current space by default. Pass target_space_id to configure a Magic Table
space from a Conduct or command space that acts as its configuration interface.
Module-level parameters (language_model, columns, etc.) patch the RfpAgent module config.
Space-level parameters (answer_library, hide_sheet_status, etc.) patch
space.settings.magicTableConfig. Only provided (non-None) parameters are written.
Use get_magic_table_config first to inspect the current state.
Creates a pre-update snapshot before applying changes.

answer_library.description: Show the Answer Library section to space members.

answer_library_access_entity_ids.description: Restrict Answer Library access to these entity IDs. Omit to show it to every space member.

auto_reprocess_on_source_add.description: If True, automatically reprocess all rows when new sources are added.

items.description: Definition of a single column in the Magic Table (RfpAgent).

assistant_prompt.description: Trigger / user prompt template for the LLM that fills this column.

editable.description: Whether users can edit cell values in this column.

language_model.description: Language model for this column. Overrides the module-level default.

name.description: Column identifier. Built-in names: Section, Question, Answers, References, HallucinationScore.

system_prompt.description: System prompt for the LLM that fills this column.

columns.description: Full column list. Providing this replaces all existing columns. Use get_magic_table_config to fetch columns you don't want to change.

disable_notifications_by_default.description: Hide the sheet notification toggle and keep default assignee emails.

items.description: An assistant shown in the Magic Table export menu.

assistant_id.description: ID of the assistant to invoke.

label.description: Button label shown in the export menu.

prompt.description: Prompt sent to the assistant when the user triggers export.

export_assistants.description: Assistants available in the export menu. Providing this list replaces all existing export assistants.

hide_sheet_status.description: Hide the sheet status indicator from users.

language_model.description: Default language model for all columns that don't override it.

question_extraction_language_model.description: Model used to extract questions from uploaded documents.

question_extraction_max_rows.description: Maximum number of questions to extract per document.

question_extraction_use_full_document.description: Extract questions from the full document in one call rather than chunk-by-chunk.

target_space_id.description: ID of the Magic Table space to update. Defaults to the current space. Set this when calling from a Conduct or command space to configure a Magic Table space that has no chat interface of its own.

name: update_magic_table_config
title: Update Magic Table Config

description: Merge config_patch into a module's configuration dict. Existing unpatched keys are kept.

config_patch.description: Keys to merge into the module's configuration dict. Existing keys not in the patch are preserved. For Conduct spaces, prefer update_conduct_config instead.

module_id.description: ID of the module to update.

name: update_module_config
title: Update Module Config

description:
Update metadata and configuration of the current space. Only provided fields are changed.

Creates a pre-update snapshot before applying changes.

alert.description: Alert text shown to users of the space.

allow_model_switching.description: Whether users may switch between models.

items.description: A custom prompt shown as a suggestion in the chat UI.

id.description: Prompt ID assigned by the platform.

prompt.description: Prompt text inserted into the chat input when selected.

title.description: Button label displayed in the chat UI.

assistant_prompts.description: Preset prompt suggestions shown to users. Each entry needs a title and a prompt. Providing this list replaces all existing prompts.

chat_upload.description: Whether users can upload files in the chat input.

explanation.description: Description / system-prompt text for the space.

is_pinned.description: Pin the space to the top of listings.

items.description: An MCP server attached to the space and its tool selection.

mcpServerId.description: ID of the MCP server to attach.

items.description: A single tool within an MCP server configuration.

isEnabled.description: Whether this tool is enabled for the space.

name.description: Tool name as registered on the MCP server.

tools.description: Per-tool enable/disable overrides. Omit to keep existing selection.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers (connectors) to configure on the space. Each entry needs an mcpServerId. Optionally supply a tools list — each tool entry needs a name and isEnabled. An empty tools list disables the server. Omitting tools keeps the existing tool selection for that server. Use get_mcp_server_status to find server IDs and current tool names.

name.description: New display name for the space.

settings.description: Settings keys to merge at space level. Platform-managed keys (magicTableConfig) are rejected — use update_magic_table_config for those.

items.description: A language model available for selection in the space settings.

displayName.description: Human-readable label shown in the UI.

switchable_language_models.description: List of models users can pick from when allow_model_switching is true. Each entry needs a displayName (shown in the UI) and a languageModel (model ID).

name: update_space
title: Update Space

custom_output_token_limit.description: Override the model's default output token limit. Set to null to use the model default.

file_name_translation_glossary.description: File name of the glossary file within the glossary scope.

language_model_translation.description: Model used for the translation step, e.g. 'AZURE_GPT_4o_2024_1120'.

items.description: A pre- or post-processing step applied during translation.

language.description: Restrict this step to a specific language, e.g. 'German'. Omit to apply to all.

post_processing.description: Steps applied after translation. Providing this list replaces all existing ones.

items.description: A pre- or post-processing step applied during translation.

language.description: Restrict this step to a specific language, e.g. 'German'. Omit to apply to all.

pre_processing.description: Steps applied before translation. Providing this list replaces all existing ones.

scope_id_translation_glossary.description: Scope ID of the KB folder containing the translation glossary.

streaming_activated.description: Stream translation tokens to the UI as they arrive.

temperature_translation.description: Sampling temperature for translation (0–2). Lower = more deterministic.
